notes: One file read by both sides: the Blender bunker tools paint by these roles, the Unity Bunker Materials window builds materials from them and checks the paint.

Paint expectations: 'rings' are the colours of the bunker's rings counted in from its seam (ring 0 is the loop shared with its blend), 'interior' the colours expected further in. For blends, 'inner' is the edge shared with the bunker, 'outer' the edge shared with the surrounding surface.

Channel sources: 'from' is $bunker (the bunker mesh's original OPCD material), $blend (the blend mesh's original OPCD material), $outer (the material the blend fades to: the source of its original OPCD Black channel; for a bunker mesh, what most of its blends fade to) or a material asset name. 'channel' is the source channel copied. 'tint' multiplies that channel's Overall Color: a number, or [r, g, b] to shift its hue (a shadow is ~0.8). 'blendStrength' overrides the channel's Blend Strength.
Black is the channel with no dominant colour (max(r,g,b) < 0.25).

'base' (bunker or blend rule, optional): the material the render material starts as before its channels are filled, i.e. where its settings outside the four channel blocks (slope shading, satellite offsets) come from. Default: the mesh's own original. $outer on a blend shades the strip exactly like the surface round it.

opcd-default.label: OPCD default
opcd-default.description: What OPCD conform and Adjust Bunker Vertex Painting produce: red rim, green then blue inside; blends red at the bunker, black at the rough.

ce-simgolf.label: ce.simgolf
ce-simgolf.description: From the 2025 Bunker Masterclass: bunker red dirt lip, black the same lip without 3D grass (tint below 1 fakes a rolled-lip shadow), green sand, blue wet floor. Blend red rough, green longer darker grass, blue grass browning into the lip dirt.

golfmap.label: golfmap (canonical)
golfmap.description: What the Blender shaping engine leaves after any recipe: blender/tools/shape_paint.py remaps each recipe's colours (blender/recipes/library.json) and OPCD's own paint to these roles. Bunker: red grass lip (the adjoining grass look, 3D grass grows), green dirt face, black dark lip without 3D grass (the adjoining grass darkened: rolled-lip shadow), blue sand. Blend: red the adjoining surface, green longer darker grass, black browning grass / dirt toward the bunker. Check paint expects the grass lip on the seam ring and no grass inside; recipes with a wide lip (kaustin: the old blend joined in) or bunkers never reshaped (dirt rim) read !! although painted right.

blend.black: adjoining surface at the hazard edge (was: browning toward the hazard)

golfmap.sourceNotes: The bunker's grass lip and shadow copy $outer: for a bunker mesh, what most of its blends fade to (rough, or fairway for a fairway bunker; it copied the rough by name before, 'OPCD MAHS Rough No Mowlines_Sat'). blendStrength 2 is OPCD's value on every channel, pinned so another surface does not soften the lip line. The blend is the surround's grass all the way to the sand (Marcus's references: grass right up to and over the edge, no brown band): every channel it paints (red at the outer edge, black at the bunker) is $outer's red, on $outer's base settings, so rough -> strip is seamless; green stays the darker, longer grass. Its black was the bunker's dirt lip ($bunker red) before, which read as a brown band. Stix 3D grass grows on the blends at an even density (golfmap.roughgrass.plant, lip material), not by their red. The dirt face (green) is the bunker's dirt lip lifted a little and toward brown-grey (tint [1.25, 1.15, 1.1]: its base is the ortho, which the edge fill made grass-coloured there, so untinted it read as a dark stripe), the shadow lip likewise ([0.88, 0.85, 0.8], was 0.8); the recipes end with golfmap.edge_jitter so the band's border with the sand is ragged, not a ruled line (Marcus, 2026-09-29).
